orientation_codes.note: confirmed from the raw per-orientation hourly files

hour_of_year: 0-8759 (0-indexed), raw hour-of-year column, not calendar hour-of-day
PPD: derived from predicted PMV via ISO 7730, not a model
interval: 90% conformal: lower=q_lo.predict(x)-Q, upper=q_hi.predict(x)+Q (Q per target in conformal.json)
note_vs_monthly: hourly mode has NO month feature (dropped by design decision); outdoor temp column here is 'outdoor mean raad temp' in the raw files (confirmed to be outdoor dry-bulb temp, a naming typo in the source data).
